from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,json,shutil
files=[Path('crates/logex-storage/src')/x for x in ['durability.rs','native/storage.rs','native/segment.rs','native/catalog.rs']]
original={p:p.read_bytes() for p in files}
try:
 p=files[0];s=p.read_text();s+='''
#[cfg(test)]
static LIVE_PROFILE: std::sync::Mutex<std::collections::BTreeMap<&'static str, (u64, std::time::Duration)>> = std::sync::Mutex::new(std::collections::BTreeMap::new());
#[cfg(test)]
pub(crate) struct LiveProfileScope(&'static str, std::time::Instant);
#[cfg(test)]
impl LiveProfileScope { pub(crate) fn new(name: &'static str) -> Self { Self(name, std::time::Instant::now()) } }
#[cfg(test)]
impl Drop for LiveProfileScope { fn drop(&mut self) { let elapsed = self.1.elapsed(); let mut profiles = LIVE_PROFILE.lock().unwrap(); let entry = profiles.entry(self.0).or_default(); entry.0 += 1; entry.1 += elapsed; } }
#[cfg(test)]
pub(crate) fn live_profile_take() -> Vec<(&'static str, u64, f64)> {
    std::mem::take(&mut *LIVE_PROFILE.lock().unwrap()).into_iter().map(|(name,(count,elapsed))| (name,count,elapsed.as_secs_f64()*1000.0)).collect()
}
'''
 s=s.replace('|| file.sync_all(),','|| { #[cfg(test)] let _scope = LiveProfileScope::new("barrier_full_fallback"); file.sync_all() },',1);p.write_text(s)
 for p,names in [(files[0],['flush_file','order_file','sync_directory','publish_ingestion_catalog_after_trees']),(files[1],['begin_ingestion','ingest_canonical_batch','checkpoint_ingestion']),(files[2],['append_ingest_rows','persist_manifest']),(files[3],['encode'])]:
  s=p.read_text()
  for name in names:
   a=s.index('fn '+name);b=s.index('{',a)+1;prefix='' if p==files[0] else 'crate::durability::'
   s=s[:b]+'\n #[cfg(test)] let _scope = '+prefix+'LiveProfileScope::new("'+name+'");'+s[b:]
  p.write_text(s)
 fixture=Path('crates/logex-storage/tests/ingestion_publication.rs').read_text().replace('use logex_storage::{PartitionManager, PartitionManagerConfig, SegmentReader};','use crate::{PartitionManager, PartitionManagerConfig, SegmentReader};')
 fixture=fixture.replace('            let start = Instant::now();','            crate::durability::live_profile_take();\n            let start = Instant::now();',1)
 fixture=fixture.replace('            assert_rows(&storage, &expected);','            println!("{}", json!({"kind":"phase_profile", "iteration":iteration, "phases":crate::durability::live_profile_take()}));\n            assert_rows(&storage, &expected);',1)
 fixture=fixture.replace('            assert_rows(&storage, &expected);', '            if iteration == 0 { println!("{}", json!({"kind":"artifact_inventory", "entries":std::fs::read_dir(&storage.hot_partition().meta.path).unwrap().map(|entry| entry.unwrap().file_name().to_string_lossy().into_owned()).collect::<Vec<_>>()})); }\n            assert_rows(&storage, &expected);',1)
 p=files[1];p.write_text(p.read_text()+'\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod audit_live_profile {\n'+fixture+'\n}\n')
 Path('/tmp/logex-live-file-inventory.diff').write_text(subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--','crates'],text=True))
 result=subprocess.run(['cargo','test','-p','logex-storage','--release','--lib','--locked','--no-run','--message-format=json'],text=True,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
 Path('/tmp/logex-live-file-inventory-build.log').write_text(result.stderr)
 if result.returncode:raise RuntimeError(result.stderr)
 matches=[json.loads(x)['executable']for x in result.stdout.splitlines()if json.loads(x).get('executable')];assert len(matches)==1
 shutil.copy2(matches[0],'/tmp/logex-live-file-inventory-tests')
 print('Instrumented diagnostic built; source will be restored',flush=True)
finally:
 for p,data in original.items():p.write_bytes(data)
print('All instrumented source restored',flush=True)

from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,os,plistlib,re,subprocess,tempfile
image=Path('/private/tmp/logex-audit-130-cross-device-gpwks2ai/exfat.dmg');mount=image.parent/'exfat';binary=Path('/tmp/logex-live-file-inventory-tests');out=Path('/tmp/logex-live-file-inventory.jsonl')
def attached():
 records=plistlib.loads(subprocess.check_output(['hdiutil','info','-plist']))
 matches=[r for r in records.get('images',[]) if Path(r['image-path']).resolve()==image.resolve()];assert len(matches)<=1
 return matches[0] if matches else None
assert image.is_file() and not image.is_symlink() and binary.is_file() and attached() is None
with out.open('w') as output:
 output.write(json.dumps({'kind':'environment','commit':subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip(),'diagnostic_only':True,'source_diff':Path('/tmp/logex-live-file-inventory.diff').read_text(),'builder_source':Path('/tmp/logex-live-file-inventory-build.py').read_text(),'runner_source':Path(__file__).read_text(),'binary_sha256':hashlib.sha256(binary.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'hardware':subprocess.check_output(['sysctl','-n','hw.model','hw.memsize','hw.ncpu'],text=True),'rustc':subprocess.check_output(['rustc','-Vv'],text=True),'os':subprocess.check_output(['sw_vers'],text=True),'limitation':'Instrumented release unit-test build; nested scope times overlap and include instrumentation costs. Not a performance acceptance comparison. All temporary instrumented source restored before execution; complete v3 row/progress/clean-reopen oracles retained. One two-block live inventory run on each filesystem. Disposable image on internal APFS; not the protected USB volume.'})+'\n');output.flush()
 def run(filesystem,parent):
  with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='logex-live-profile-',dir=parent) as temp:
   env={**os.environ,'TMPDIR':temp,'LOGEX_PUBLICATION_ROUTE':'live','LOGEX_PUBLICATION_BLOCKS':'2','LOGEX_PUBLICATION_ROWS_PER_BLOCK':'128','LOGEX_PUBLICATION_WARM_HEADERS':'8192','LOGEX_PUBLICATION_HISTORY_BLOCKS':'2048','LOGEX_PUBLICATION_SEGMENT_ROWS':'1000000','LOGEX_PUBLICATION_REPEATS':'1','LOGEX_PUBLICATION_HEADER_FIELDS':'minimal','LOGEX_PUBLICATION_CHECKPOINT_EACH_BLOCK':'1','LOGEX_PUBLICATION_DURABLE_CHECKPOINT':'0'}
   logfile=Path('/tmp/logex-live-file-inventory-'+filesystem+'.log');print('Profiling',filesystem,flush=True)
   with logfile.open('w') as log:r=subprocess.run([str(binary),'audit_live_profile::benchmark_sync_storage_publication','--ignored','--nocapture','--test-threads=1'],env=env,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
   if r.returncode:raise RuntimeError(str(logfile))
   for line in logfile.read_text().splitlines():
    if '{' not in line:continue
    try:record=json.loads(line[line.index('{'):])
    except json.JSONDecodeError:continue
    output.write(json.dumps({**record,'filesystem':filesystem})+'\n')
    if record.get('kind') in ['phase_profile','artifact_inventory']:print(filesystem,record,flush=True)
   output.flush()
 run('apfs','/private/tmp')
 assert mount.is_dir() and not mount.is_symlink() and os.stat(mount).st_dev==os.stat(image.parent).st_dev
 subprocess.check_call(['hdiutil','attach',str(image),'-mountpoint',str(mount),'-nobrowse'])
 try:
  selected=attached();assert selected is not None and any(x.get('mount-point')==str(mount)for x in selected['system-entities'])
  volume=plistlib.loads(subprocess.check_output(['diskutil','info','-plist',str(mount)]));assert volume['FilesystemType']=='exfat'
  run('exfat',mount)
 finally:
  selected=attached()
  if selected is not None:
   assert any(x.get('mount-point')==str(mount)for x in selected['system-entities'])
   devices=[x['dev-entry']for x in selected['system-entities']if re.fullmatch(r'/dev/disk[0-9]+',x.get('dev-entry',''))];assert len(devices)==1
   subprocess.check_call(['hdiutil','detach',devices[0]])
  assert attached() is None
  print('Disposable image detached',flush=True)
